notes.title: The Winds of Adventure!
notes.content: [p]The Winds of Adventure are picking up![/p][p]We’re preparing for full release and this build is a big one. It tightens combat, deepens the world, and adds a mountain of goals for achievement hunters. Here’s what’s inside:[/p][list][*][p]54 Steam Achievements — From boss slayers and exploration milestones to mastery challenges. Track your legend across every biome.[/p][/*][*][p]Complete Combat Overhaul — Movement feel, hit-pause, timing windows, and enemy reactions have been tuned for punchier, more readable fights.[/p][/*][*][p]New: Power Strike — A precise, high-impact attack that breaks guards, staggers tougher foes, and opens combo routes when timed just right.[/p][/*][*][p]New NPC Interactions — Fresh lines, small favors, and reactive barks bring towns and wilds to life. Some conversations lead to secrets…[/p][/*][*][p]World-Building & Dialogue Enhancements — Cleaner delivery, richer lore, and better pacing across story beats.[/p][/*][*][p]Much, Much More — QoL tweaks, performance passes, controller feel polish, bug fixes, and visual touches throughout.[/p][/*][/list][p]As we head into full release, your feedback is priceless. Drop thoughts (and bug reports) in the Discussions and let me know what you want to see polished next. Thanks for riding these winds with me and helping me see my dreams come true.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch #1
notes.content:
The Demo has been out for only a few days now and already a few great players have found a couple of small areas that could use some improvement. That being said, here they are.
[list]
[*] Better GUI for indicating when the player is or is not healing at a campfire
[*] Quicker enemy attacks to make dodging feel a bit more robust
[*] Tavern-Keep Interactions smoothed out so that it feels better for the player to get there gold
[*] Special Easter Egg added in for the few players that think they can break the Demo Walls down ;p
[/list]
These are the few core issues that were sniffed out and fixed. Thanks again for every player and wishlister out there. As a Solo Developer working on there dream project it means the world!

notes.title: Beast and Cleaver - Demo and Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[h2]Game News[/h2]
Welcome to the world of Beast and Cleaver everyone! This is the first of many news updates over the next few months leading up to the games full release on October 1st, 2025. 

As of today players are able to see more than just the steam store page... introducing the Demo! 

[b]What's included in the Demo?[/b]
[list]
[*] The entire first biome including 5 enemy variations
[*] 1 of the games six difficult and strategic boss fights
[*] 6 Demo specific quest related to the Demos open biome
[/list]
The Demo is estimated to take a new player around 30-60 minutes, or just enough to see the games core values. 

Another huge piece of news for the game is that we are officially registered as a part of this upcoming Spring Next Fest! This means publicity, and the potential for player to get the chance to see the game and get excited for it in these months prior to full release!

[h2]Personal Message[/h2]
Nearly one year ago I found a passion for game creation, this has lead to the creation of Beast and Cleaver. Many sleepless nights and coffees later the game is nearly ready for its full release, though its progress is still progressing.

That being said, I want to give a HUGE thank you to each and every person that reads this and takes time out of there day to give my game a chance. So truly, from a solo developer, thank you.
